stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G010】不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配；【G015】分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 动词后接不定式（to do）还是动名词（doing）取决于动词配价规约；同时注意 warrant, facilitate, advocate, involve, consider, anticipate 等核心学术动词的补足语限制。
rules: 接动名词（doing）或名词、不接不定式的典型动词：consider, involve, advocate, anticipate, recommend, suggest, warrant（warrant further investigation / warrant revising），facilitate（facilitate comparison，严禁写 *facilitate sb to do）。
接不定式（to do）的典型动词：aim, attempt, tend, seek, intend, resolve, enable sb to do, allow sb to do, force sb to do, oblige sb to do。
examples: The report advocates providing clearer information to applicants.
The procedure involves checking every record twice.
A common reporting format can facilitate comparison across studies.
common_errors: 误用不定式：*warrant to conclude / *facilitate researchers to compare / *advocate to provide / *involve to check。

grammar_instruction.name: 分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 分词短语能将冗长的从句浓缩为紧凑的后置定语或状语；但句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语完全一致，绝不可产生悬垂修饰（Dangling Modifier）。
rules: 后置分词定语：records exceeding the limit (= that exceed...)；predictions compared with ground-truth labels (= that are compared...)。
句首分词状语主语一致铁律：Using a 48-step look-back window, the model reduces MSE（the model 可以 use window；但不能写 *Using a 48-step window, the MSE decreases，因为 MSE 不会自己 use window！）。
examples: Records exceeding the stated size limit were excluded.
Compared with earlier studies, this study used a larger sample.
Halving the sampling interval doubles the sampling frequency.
common_errors: 悬垂分词：*Training on synthetic data, the generalization error remained high（应改为 When the model was trained on synthetic data, ... 或 Training on synthetic data left the model with high generalization error）。

grammar_instruction.name: 句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 句子改写必须在改变句法或词汇结构的同时，100% 保持原句的事实范围、否定、时间、程度和认知确定性，并能准确诊断语法错误、表达不自然、语域不当与语义扭曲。
rules: 限定守恒：原句的 provided that, in this sample, under Gaussian-kernel assumptions, may, arguably 等在改写后必须保留等价限定。
多路径自然改写：支持动词 <-> 派生名词转换、从句 <-> 介词短语转换、主动 <-> 被动焦点转换，提供多个自然可接受版本。
examples:
Source: Missing records account for the discrepancy between the totals.
Rewrite 1: The discrepancy between the totals is attributable to missing records.
Rewrite 2: Missing records explain why the two totals differ.
common_errors: 在改写中偷换概念或将相关关系升级为因果结论。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 消融实验（Ablation Study）与基线公平对比（Fair Baseline Comparison）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To disentangle the contribution of [Component A] from [Component B], we compare the full model against a conventional baseline under comparable conditions.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于实验与消融分析章节，严谨剥离各模块的独立贡献，避免只挑有利指标汇报（selective reporting）。
examples: Every proposed method should be compared against a relevant baseline under comparable conditions.
The study design aims to disentangle the effect of training from prior experience.
common_errors: 使用 unparallelled / groundbreaking 等空洞吹嘘词代替具体的消融实验差值与误差棒说明。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00282 v. phrase] 以……为依据（例：The argument is based on the stated assumptions.）；[V00283 v. phrase] 基于（例：The estimate is based on verified records.） | 本条用法约束：on；不要把 based on 当作证明全部外推结论。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The argument is based on the stated assumptions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00282 v. phrase] 以……为依据（例：The argument is based on the stated assumptions.）；[V00283 v. phrase] 基于（例：The estimate is based on verified records.） | 本条用法约束：主动 base A on B。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The estimate is based on verified records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：bear的过去分词为borne；不等于普遍证明。
key_collocations: be borne out by independent data
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The pattern was borne out by independent measurements.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：正式也可写 be invited to an interview。
key_collocations: call an applicant for an interview
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The applicant was called for an interview after the initial review.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：被动搭配 by。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The archive records are complemented by interviews.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：with；不同于 concerned about 表担忧。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The review is concerned with forecast evaluation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不保证适用于其他环境。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The findings are confined to the evaluated setting.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：to 后接名词或动名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: One section is devoted to methods.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：into；与 consists of 结构不同。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report is divided into three sections.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：主动 expose A to B。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The samples were exposed to sunlight.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：宾语指组成部分；不可写成 is made up researchers。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The panel is made up of researchers and community representatives.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：offer 可能附条件；收到 offer 不一定已完成注册。
key_collocations: offer someone a place on a course
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The candidate was offered a place on the course.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00294 discourse phrase] 即便如此（例：The model fits these data well. Be that as it may, its assumptions still require scrutiny.）；[V00295 让步短语] 即便如此（例：The sample is small. Be that as it may, the protocol warrants further testing.） | 本条用法约束：39.4 选项中的扩展表达，论证需给出具体所承认之点。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The model fits these data well. Be that as it may, its assumptions still require scrutiny.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00294 discourse phrase] 即便如此（例：The model fits these data well. Be that as it may, its assumptions still require scrutiny.）；[V00295 让步短语] 即便如此（例：The sample is small. Be that as it may, the protocol warrants further testing.） | 本条用法约束：偏正式且有修辞色彩，教材提示多见于口语；论文通常可用 nevertheless。
key_collocations: be that as it may, further work
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The sample is small. Be that as it may, the protocol warrants further testing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：bear out 后接宾语；过去式 bore out。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The new observations do not bear out the hypothesis.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：beautify 构词去掉 beauty 的 y；beautification 为名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The council proposed measures to beautify the public square.
